title: The /admin/qr visual check stops failing on every render: the check-in code previews, signed per second since LIVE-688, are one registered mask site
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1697), one of the three regressions LIVE-213's recapture (#3109) left on main. THE CONSEQUENCE: the four /admin/qr visual looks failed pr-compare on every run, with a different pixel count on each retry. MEASURED on #3109: two captures of the same tree about 30 minutes apart (runs 36667124353, 36676490803) agreed on 114 of 118 files and differed only on the four admin-qr files, in 96 x 96 bands over the check-in QR codes. LIVE-688 (ADR-1654) signs each node code over (node id, issued-at in unix seconds), and app/(main)/admin/qr/page.tsx signs a fresh one (signedNodeUrl) on every render, so the encoded URL and every module change from one second to the next. THE FIX, picture only: the preview box in NodeCard (qr-studio.tsx, the div that inlines node.svg, a fixed w-28 h-28) carries data-visual-mask="qr-node-code", registered in VISUAL_MASK_SITES (test/e2e/surfaces.ts) as kind live with its reason citing LIVE-688. The box is fixed, so the mask holds it (visual-masks.test.ts guards registry and tree both ways). The signing is untouched: the issued-at is the code's security meaning. The other previews on the page (dynamic links, marketing and member profile codes) encode unsigned /q/<slug> URLs and stay in the picture, as do each card's label, badges, counts and actions. The four admin-qr baselines are recaptured through e2e-manual.yml (update_baselines + capture_shell) against this branch's preview, because a newly masked box paints differently from a baseline taken without it. Readings in the PR body.

LIVE-736 masks the picture and must not change the signing");for(const t of ["dawn-light-desktop","dawn-dark-desktop","dawn-light-mobile","dawn-dark-mobile"]){const p="test/e2e/__screenshots__/visual.spec.ts/admin-qr--"+t+".png";if(!fs.existsSync(p))fail(p+" is gone")}console.log("LIVE-736: the check-in code previews on /admin/qr are one registered mask site (qr-node-code, fixed w-28 h-28 box), and the per-second signing is unchanged")'
